explanation.why_it_matters: The container base image node:12-alpine is built on alpine 3.15.4, which trivy reports as end-of-service-life, meaning no further security updates are published for its OS packages. Every OS-level vulnerability in that image therefore has no upstream fix path, and the image scan separately reported 11 critical and 74 high package matches. This risk is independent of the npm dependency CVEs because it lives in the base image layer.
explanation.confidence_reason: The EOSL determination comes directly from trivy image metadata. Reachability and provenance are unknown and the score rests on only 0.15 weight coverage, so the numeric score understates the structural problem; the EOSL fact itself is solid.

explanation.why_it_matters: grunt-if@0.2.0 is a direct devDependency whose lockfile entry resolves to https://github.com/binarymist/grunt-if/tarball/master, a mutable branch ref rather than an immutable commit SHA. The tarball behind that URL can change without any package-lock.json change, so reviewed and installed artifacts can diverge silently. As a build-time dependency, substituted content would run in CI or on a developer machine.
